findings.text: Changed type assertion from `obj.(Mock)` to `obj.(*Mock)` breaks callers passing Mock value types. When a Mock value (not pointer) is passed to AssertExpectationsForObjects, the type assertion fails, obj remains unchanged, and the subsequent `obj.(assertExpectationser)` panics because Mock value doesn't implement the interface (only *Mock does). The original code handled both cases by taking the address of value types.
